verdict.rationale: mParticle documents GDPR/CCPA compliance tooling — consent state management, consent filters, and forwarding rules like 'do not forward if CCPA data sale opt-out is present' — which supports suppression enforcement to downstream destinations. However, the evidence never explicitly names a Data Subject Request/deletion API workflow that processes and forwards actual user deletion requests to connected destinations, only consent-based suppression filtering. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a deletion/erasure request workflow (not just opt-out/consent suppression), and independent confirmation that deletion requests actually propagate to third-party destinations.
